violation_type.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Infant Feeding Instructions (26 TAC §746.801(2))
violation_type.short_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Infant Feeding Instructions
violation_type.typical_finding: Multiple record keeping items were not made available to the Child Care Regulation Inspector for review at the time of the monitoring inspection.

finding_variants.text: Multiple record keeping items were not made available to the Child Care Regulation Inspector for review at the time of the monitoring inspection.
Three infants were missing current feeding schedules.
Written feeding instructions were not available for review for an infant not ready for table food.
Two children did not have feeding instructions.
At the time of the inspection 15 infants did not have current feeding instructions available for review.
One infant requiring feeding instructions does not have feeding instructions on file.
